title: Blood-Bank Typing Value on Outpatient Surgery Refunds — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Payer agreement term.** On an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) whose post-payment denial of outpatient surgery is refunded, the blood-bank typing codes 86900 and 86901 under revenue code 0300 (read together, by charges and billed units, from the charge postings of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)) carry this value:

The blood-bank typing codes keep no value of their own when a Commercial PPO claim bills code 29882 under revenue code 0360 (Riverbend's PPO agreements bundle pre-operative typing with that knee procedure), are valued at their billed units (read together) times 11.50 USD on a Commercial HMO claim, and are valued at the payer class's expected allowed percentage of their charges otherwise.

- **Commercial PPO Claim that bills code 29882 under revenue code 0360:** no value of their own.
- **Commercial HMO Claim:** their billed units, read together, times 11.50 USD.
- **Otherwise:** the payer class's expected allowed percentage of their charges.

The typing value is never above the typing codes' billed charges.

**Condition table**
| Payer class | Code 29882 billed under revenue code 0360 | Typing value |
|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim | yes | 0.00 |
| Commercial PPO Claim | no | expected allowed percentage of the typing charges |
| Commercial HMO Claim | either | billed units times 11.50, capped at the typing charges |
| Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim | either | expected allowed percentage of the typing charges |

Example (hypothetical): a Commercial HMO Claim with 3 typing units and typing charges of 90.00 values the typing at 34.50; with typing charges of 30.00 it is capped at 30.00.
